My personal website which serves as both a portfolio project, and a way to share my portfolio.

Written in Python using NiceGUI and deployed on a shared VPS.

Configured with Github actions for updates behind Nginx.

A social media site concept idea allowing friends to share telegram like notes to eachother.

Vue / FastAPI application on a shared VPS. Connects to a MongoDB via a private Tailscale connection.
Vue SPA for use with KitBash KVM, my opensource hardware / software project for building a device to admin local machines by capturing video and sending keyboard and mouse control commands.
A utility for assisting those writing coding tutorials by automating coding tasks. Python Multiprocess application using a MQTT backend for inter-process communication.
A local web redirect allowing local aliasing of common IP or web URLS to short aliases.
